```{r load_data_alpha, comment="", message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
load("data/data.Rdata")
```

## Functional differences


```{r}
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts_raw[rownames(genome_gifts_raw) %in% genome_counts_filt$genome,]
genome_gifts <- genome_gifts[, colSums(genome_gifts != 0) > 0]

# Aggregate bundle-level GIFTs into the compound level
GIFTs_elements <- to.elements(genome_gifts, GIFT_db2)

# remove elements with 0 GIFT association 
GIFTs_elements_filtered <- GIFTs_elements[rownames(GIFTs_elements) %in% genome_counts$genome, ]
GIFTs_elements_filtered <- as.data.frame(GIFTs_elements_filtered) %>%
  select_if(~ !is.numeric(.) || sum(.) != 0)

elements <- GIFTs_elements_filtered %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Aggregate element-level GIFTs into the function level
GIFTs_functions <- to.functions(GIFTs_elements_filtered, GIFT_db2)
functions <- GIFTs_functions %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Aggregate function-level GIFTs into overall Biosynthesis, Degradation and Structural GIFTs
GIFTs_domains <- to.domains(GIFTs_functions, GIFT_db2)
domains <- GIFTs_domains %>%
  as.data.frame()

# Get community-weighed average GIFTs per sample
GIFTs_elements_community <- to.community(GIFTs_elements_filtered, tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
GIFTs_functions_community <- to.community(GIFTs_functions,tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
GIFTs_domains_community <- to.community(GIFTs_domains,tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
```


```{r}
merge(
  GIFTs_domains %>% as.data.frame(),
  genome_metadata[genome_metadata$class %in% c("c__Gammaproteobacteria",
                                               "c__Bacteroidia",
                                               "c__Bacilli"
                                               ),
                  c("genome","class")] %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="genome"), by = 0, all = F
  ) %>% mutate(across(c('class'), substr, 4, nchar(class))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(GIFTs_domains)) %>%
   
  ggplot(aes(x=name, y=value, facet = name, colour = class)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = unique(tmp_xtick)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = 'class', 
                     values = c("Gammaproteobacteria" = '#E0A608',
                                "Bacteroidia" = '#823838',
                                "Bacilli" = '#086C98'),
                     drop = FALSE) +
   ylab("GIFT Probability") +
   ylim(0,1) +
   xlab("GIFT Element") +
   theme(
     axis.title.y = element_blank(),
     axis.title.x = element_blank(),
     axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", hjust=0.95,vjust=0.2,
                                colour = c("#706513","#520120","#08403E"))
         )
```

```{r}

# limit to specific classes
GIFTs_elements_long =
merge(
  GIFTs_elements %>% as.data.frame(),
  genome_metadata[genome_metadata$class %in% c("c__Gammaproteobacteria",
                                               "c__Bacteroidia"#,
                                               #"c__Bacilli"
                                               ),
                  c("genome","class")] %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="genome"), by = 0, all = F
  ) %>% mutate(across(c('class'), substr, 4, nchar(class))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(GIFTs_elements)) 

# run Wilcox rank test
wcox = list()
Wstat = list()
Wpval = list()

for (e in seq_along(colnames(GIFTs_elements))){
  
  wcox[[e]] = wilcox.test(value ~ class, GIFTs_elements_long[GIFTs_elements_long$name==colnames(GIFTs_elements)[e],])
  Wstat[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$statistic
  Wpval[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$p.value

}

WCox_GIFT_element =
  data.frame(element = colnames(GIFTs_elements),
           W = unlist(Wstat),
           p = unlist(Wpval)
  )

WCox_GIFT_element =
  WCox_GIFT_element %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(p))

# return element names
GIFTs_elements_long$element =
  GIFT_db2[match(GIFTs_elements_long$name,GIFT_db2$Code_element),"Element"]

GIFTs_elements_long$domain =
  GIFT_db2[match(GIFTs_elements_long$name,GIFT_db2$Code_element),"Domain"]

GIFTs_elements_sig =
GIFTs_elements_long[GIFTs_elements_long$name %in% 
                      na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$padj<0.01,])$element, 
                    ] %>%
  mutate_at(c("domain", "element"), as.factor)

# plot differences
GIFTs_elements_sig %>%  
   ggplot(aes(x=element, y=value, colour = class)) + 
  #geom_boxplot(varwidth = TRUE, notch = F, outlier.alpha = 0.1) +
  geom_jitter(size=.4, alpha=0.9) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = class, colour = class), size = 4, shape = 18, geom = "point", fun = "mean") +
  facet_grid(~domain, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme_classic() +
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = unique(tmp_xtick)) +
  scale_color_manual(name = 'class', 
                     values = c("Gammaproteobacteria" = '#E0A608',
                                "Bacteroidia" = '#823838' #,
                                #"Bacilli" = '#086C98'
                                ),
                     drop = FALSE) +
   ylab("GIFT Probability") +
   ylim(0,1) +
   xlab("GIFT Element") +
   theme(
     legend.position = "top", 
     legend.title = element_blank(),
     axis.title.y = element_blank(),
     axis.title.x = element_blank(),
     axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", hjust=0.95,vjust=0.2)
   ) ->
  fig_gift_class_comparison

fig_gift_class_comparison

```

#### WilCox Comparison

```{r}
# Generate temporary dataframe
tmp_GIFTs = GIFTs_elements_community %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="sample")
# identify functions will less than an average 0.1 functional association per sample
low.funct.GIFTS = colnames(tmp_GIFTs[,-1])[colSums(tmp_GIFTs[,-1]) <= (nrow(tmp_GIFTs) * .3)]

habitat_GIFT_element =
  GIFTs_elements_community %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    
  select(!low.funct.GIFTS) %>%
    
    rownames_to_column(var="sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(!sample,names_to="trait",values_to="gift") %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
    select(sample,trait,gift,event_ID,habitat)

wcox = list()
Wstat = list()
Wpval = list()

for (e in seq_along(unique(habitat_GIFT_element$trait))){
  
  wcox[[e]] = wilcox.test(gift ~ habitat, habitat_GIFT_element[habitat_GIFT_element$trait==unique(habitat_GIFT_element$trait)[e],])
  Wstat[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$statistic
  Wpval[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$p.value

}

WCox_GIFT_element =
  data.frame(element = unique(habitat_GIFT_element$trait),
           W = unlist(Wstat),
           p = unlist(Wpval))



# return element names
WCox_GIFT_element$name =
  GIFT_db2[match(WCox_GIFT_element$element,GIFT_db2$Code_element),"Element"]

WCox_GIFT_element$domain =
  GIFT_db2[match(WCox_GIFT_element$element,GIFT_db2$Code_element),"Domain"]

WCox_GIFT_element$padj =
  p.adjust(WCox_GIFT_element$p)

GIFTs_elements_sig =
GIFTs_elements_long[GIFTs_elements_long$name %in% 
                      na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$padj<0.05,])$element, 
                    ] %>%
  mutate_at(c("domain", "element"), as.factor)


merge(
  na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$padj < 0.05,]),
  GIFT_db[,c("Code_element","Domain","Function","Element")], by.x = "element", by.y = "Code_element"
  ) %>%
  unique.data.frame()
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
aggregate( gift ~ habitat + trait, tmp_GIFT_element, mean )

tmp_GIFT_element[tmp_GIFT_element$trait %in% na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$p < 0.05,])$element, ] %>% 
  group_by(trait, habitat) %>%  # First group by cyl, then by gear within cyl
  summarize(mean_gift = mean(gift, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_gift = sd(gift, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = 'drop')
```

### GIFTs Functions
 
```{r}
unique(GIFT_db2$Function)[
  match(
    colnames(GIFTs_functions_community),
    unique(GIFT_db2$Code_function)
  )] -> names_functions

GIFTs_functions_community %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    `colnames<-`(c(names_functions)) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(!sample,names_to="trait",values_to="gift") %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
    rename(Function = trait) %>%
    left_join(GIFT_db2, by = join_by(Function == Function)) %>%
    mutate(
    Function = str_replace(
      Function,
      pattern = "biosynthesis",
      replacement = ""
      )) %>%
    mutate(
      Function = str_replace(
      Function,
      pattern = "degradation",
      replacement = ""
      )) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x=Function,y=sample,fill=gift)) +
        geom_tile(colour="white", linewidth=0.2)+
        scale_fill_gradientn(colours=rev(c("#d53e4f", "#f46d43", "#fdae61", "#fee08b", "#e6f598", "#abdda4", "#ddf1da")))+
        facet_wrap(~Domain, scales="free") +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust=0.95, size = 8),
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
        )

ggsave(paste0('figure/habitat_gift_function.png'), width=15, height=10, units='cm')
```

## ANCOMB2 Identified Taxa

```{r}
# list of taxa with significant relative abundance differences
ancombc_rand_table_mag = readRDS("data/ancombc_rand_table_mag.Rds")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
genome_GIFTs_relabund =
  GIFTs_elements_filtered[
    row.names(GIFTs_elements_filtered) %in% ancombc_rand_table_mag$genome,]

GIFTs_elements_Hcomm <- to.community(genome_GIFTs_relabund, tss(genome_counts_filt[-1]), GIFT_db2)
```

```{r}
# Generate temporary dataframe
tmp_GIFTs = GIFTs_elements_Hcomm %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="sample")
# identify functions will less than an average 0.1 functional association per sample
low.funct.GIFTS = colnames(tmp_GIFTs[,-1])[colSums(tmp_GIFTs[,-1]) <= (nrow(tmp_GIFTs) * .1)]


df_GIFT_H.element =
  GIFTs_elements_Hcomm %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    
  select(!low.funct.GIFTS) %>%
    
    rownames_to_column(var="sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(!sample,names_to="trait",values_to="gift") %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>%
    select(sample,trait,gift,event_ID,habitat)

wcox = list()
Wstat = list()
Wpval = list()

for (e in seq_along(unique(df_GIFT_H.element$trait))){
  
  wcox[[e]] = wilcox.test(gift ~ habitat, df_GIFT_H.element[df_GIFT_H.element$trait==unique(df_GIFT_H.element$trait)[e],])
  Wstat[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$statistic
  Wpval[[e]] = wcox[[e]]$p.value

}

WCox_GIFT_element =
  data.frame(element = unique(df_GIFT_H.element$trait),
           W = unlist(Wstat),
           p = p.adjust(unlist(Wpval), method="fdr"))


merge(
  na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$p < 0.05,]),
  GIFT_db[,c("Code_element","Domain","Function","Element")], by.x = "element", by.y = "Code_element"
  ) %>%
  unique.data.frame()
```

```{r}
GIFTs_elements_Hcomm %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="sample") %>%
    pivot_longer(!sample,names_to="trait",values_to="gift") %>%
    left_join(sample_metadata, by = join_by(sample == sample)) %>% 
  
  filter(trait %in% na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$p < 0.05,]$element)) %>%
```

```{r}
    select_if(colSums(genome_GIFTs_relabund[grep("bin.31",rownames(genome_GIFTs_relabund)),] ) > .75)

)
```

## Habitat Exlusive Taxa 

Limit the comparison to only those habitat exclusive taxa, i.e. 

### Families

Erysipelotrichaceae (phylum Bacillota; 3 MAGs) and Pseudonocardiaceae (phylum Actinomycetota; 3 MAGs), exclusive to rural habitats

Chitinophagaceae (phylum Bacteroidota; 5 MAGs) and Steroidobacteraceae (phylum Pseudomonadota, 2 MAGs), exclusive to urban habitats

```{r}
# list of families exclusive to one habitat
hab.exclusive_fam = c("f__Erysipelotrichaceae","f__Pseudonocardiaceae","f__Chitinophagaceae","f__Steroidobacteraceae")
```



```{r}
tmp_xtick =
  unique(GIFT_db[GIFT_db2$Code_element %in%
            unique(df_GIFT_H.element[df_GIFT_H.element$trait %in% na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$p < 0.05,])$element,]$trait),
          ]$Element)

ggplot(
  df_GIFT_H.element[df_GIFT_H.element$trait %in% na.omit(WCox_GIFT_element[WCox_GIFT_element$p < 0.05,])$element,],
  aes(x=trait, y=gift, facet = trait, colour = habitat)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = tmp_xtick) +
  scale_color_manual(name = 'habitat', 
                     values = c("rural" = '#5bae63',"urban" = '#986eac'),
                     drop = FALSE) +
   ylab("GIFT Probability") +
   xlab("GIFT Element") +
   theme(
     axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, face = "bold", 
                                colour = c("#706513","#706513","#706513","#520120","#520120"))
         )

```

The following is a list of taxa that differ between each habitat in log fold change.

```{r}
# MAGs that significantly differ in LFC between habitats 
lfc.mags = readRDS("./figure/table_lfc.RDS")[,"MAG"]
```

Does the inferred function of these groups significantly differ from the mean?

```{r}
merge(
  GIFTs_functions %>% as.data.frame(),
  genome_metadata[,c("genome","phylum")] %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="genome"), 
  by = 0, all = F) %>% 
  mutate(across(c('phylum'), substr, 4, nchar(phylum))) %>%
  # indicate if significant
  mutate(lfc.p= if_else(Row.names %in% lfc.mags, 'sig', 'ns')) %>%
  #remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="Row.names") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(GIFTs_functions)) %>%

# plot results
ggplot(aes(x=name, y=value, colour = lfc.p)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(size=0.4, alpha=0.9) +
  theme_minimal() +
  #scale_x_discrete(labels = unique(tmp_xtick)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "red")) +
   ylab("GIFT Probability") +
   ylim(0,1) +
   xlab("GIFT Element") +
   theme(
     axis.title.y = element_blank(),
     axis.title.x = element_blank(),
     axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, face = "bold", hjust=0.95,vjust=0.2)
         )
```

```{r}
# number of significant MAGs
length(lfc.mags)

# randomly select equal number form remainder
lfc.sample =
sample(
  rownames(GIFTs_functions)[!rownames(GIFTs_functions) %in% lfc.mags], # excluding sig
  length(lfc.mags),
  replace = F
)

lfc.p_GIFTs =
merge(
  GIFTs_functions %>% as.data.frame(),
  genome_metadata[,c("genome","phylum")] %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="genome"), 
  by = 0, all = F) %>% 
  mutate(across(c('phylum'), substr, 4, nchar(phylum))) %>%
  
  # indicate if significant
  mutate(lfc.p= if_else(Row.names %in% lfc.mags, 'sig', 'ns')) %>%
  
  # filter to all sig.LFC and equal sample of those not significant
#  filter(Row.names %in% c(lfc.mags,lfc.sample)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = colnames(GIFTs_functions))


funct_elements = levels(as.factor(lfc.p_GIFTs$name))
p.tmp = list()
stat.tmp = list()

# test for difference between significant and equal number of sample non-significant taxa 
for (i in seq_along(funct_elements)){
  tmp =
  # use wilcox rank test as distribution is not normal
  wilcox.test(value ~ lfc.p, 
       data = lfc.p_GIFTs[lfc.p_GIFTs$name==funct_elements[i],])
  p.tmp[i] = tmp$p.value
  stat.tmp[i] = tmp$statistic
}

df_lfc_funct_elements = 
  cbind.data.frame(funct_elements,
                   GIFT_db[match(funct_elements,GIFT_db$Code_function),"Function"],
                   GIFT_db[match(funct_elements,GIFT_db$Code_function),"Element"],
                   unlist(stat.tmp),
                   p.adjust(unlist(p.tmp),method = "fdr", n = length(funct_elements))
                   ) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c("code","function","element", "stat", "p"))

# significant differences between functional elements after FDR 
df_lfc_funct_elements[df_lfc_funct_elements$p < 0.05,]
```
